semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes, such as Sorter Merge, EFEM, SMIF, Robot, and Loadport products.
summary: Hung Ching Development Company Limited, established in 2010 and headquartered in Zhubei City, focuses on developing and repairing critical semiconductor equipment like Sorter Merge, EFEM, SMIF, Robot, and Loadport products. The company also distributes Kawasaki robotic arms, achieving significant sales in Taiwan.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Operates service centers in Hsinchu and Tainan, providing technical support and achieving top sales rankings for Kawasaki robotic arms.
regional_presence.China: Has service centers in Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Tianjin to support domestic and international customers.
